stack.nuxt_ui: transitive via @narduk-enterprises/narduk-core/nuxt (not a direct dep); UMain/UButton/UInput/UFormField/USelect used in templates, e.g. apps/web/app/components/border/BorderWaitControls.vue

local_reimplementations.name: PortDetailPanel breadcrumb nav
local_reimplementations.notes: Hand-rolled 2-link <nav aria-label="Border crossing breadcrumbs"> at lines 24-27 instead of narduk-core's globally-registered AppBreadcrumbs; small but a clean miss since the component is already auto-registered by the narduk-core module this app already imports.

local_reimplementations.name: BorderWaitControls
local_reimplementations.notes: Dead code: a full search+lane-mode+border+sort filter bar (UFormField/UInput/USelect) with defineModel bindings, never imported by any page or component (grep '<BorderWaitControls' and 'BorderWaitControls' both return only the component's own file). Worth flagging to Logan rather than counting as an active pattern.

sort_control.notes: sortOrder defineModel ('Longest wait' | 'Name'); unused component, see local_reimplementations.

filter_search_bar.notes: Combined search input + lane-mode segmented control + border USelect; dead code (0 consumers).
Live, mobile bottom-sheet style search UI used from LocationAwarePortFinder.vue.

freshness_indicator.notes: Thin adapter over narduk-ui's NsFreshnessChip; maps app-specific FreshnessState ('fresh'|'warning'|'stale') onto the design system's SignalState ('live'|'aging'|'stale'|'void'). This is correct adoption, not a duplicate.

error_state.notes:
Single inline

banner, no shared AppEmptyState-style component.

card_list.notes: Groups all crossings by border region (Canada/Mexico/other) into labeled card groups, client-side sort by REGION_SORT_ORDER map.
Largest component in the app: geolocation-sorted card list combining search sheet + lane-mode filter + LocationAwareCrossingCard list.
Appears unused (0 tag consumers found); possibly superseded by LocationAwareCrossingCard.

detail_list.notes: Key/value detail stats grid (status, hours, etc.) for a single port.

number_currency_format.notes: Domain-specific wait-time formatters (formatWaitMinutes, compactWaitMinutes, waitSeverity, formatFreshness, labelLaneCategory/Type); not a generic date/currency formatter.

breadcrumbs.notes: See local_reimplementations; duplicates AppBreadcrumbs. Separately, pages/ports/index.vue and pages/ports/[slug].vue call useBreadcrumbSchema() for JSON-LD only, not UI.

other.notes: Geolocation-driven port finder combining several patterns (search, filter, card list); bespoke to this app's use case, low reuse value outside border-crossing apps.

top_extraction_candidates.name: FreshnessBadge adapter pattern
top_extraction_candidates.why: Model of correct adoption (thin label-vocabulary adapter over NsFreshnessChip) other apps' freshness reimplementations should be measured against; not itself extractable further.

top_extraction_candidates.name: Replace hand-rolled breadcrumb nav with AppBreadcrumbs
top_extraction_candidates.why: narduk-core (already a module dependency here) globally registers AppBreadcrumbs; this app never adopted it.

notes: Smallest app in this lane (16 vue files). No table/pagination pattern exists anywhere -- border-waits.get.ts returns the full unpaginated dataset and the UI renders it as region-grouped cards. BorderWaitControls.vue (a full filter+sort bar) and CrossingCard.vue are both dead code (0 consumers) -- worth flagging to Logan before counting them toward any 'apps hand-roll X a lot' argument. gh issue/PR search for table/pagination/sort/mobile/hydration/empty turned up nothing UI-relevant (only a CI/deploy issue and dependency-bump PRs).
